description: Shared Renovate config for the candril terminal tools — lane, monq, presto, riff, topiq — and this distribution repo. Each of them carries a renovate.json that extends this file and nothing else, so a policy change here reaches all six.

schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: release.yml and deploy-site.yml are written by scripts/sync.sh from templates/, so a bump landed in a tool repo is reverted by the next sync. They are excluded via ignorePaths above and updated in this repo's templates/ instead.

OpenTUI is pre-1.0, moves fast, and every one of these apps is built on it. A bump is a migration to read, not a PR to merge, so it waits for a tick on the dependency dashboard rather than opening one unasked.
The docs site is a separate project from the app; its stack moves together and breaks visibly in the deploy workflow.
Lint, format and type tooling, in one PR.
